messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Question about na.omit/procd.lm
parts:
Have you confirmed that there are NAs in your data?

"Error in -omits : invalid argument to unary operator" is triggered when there is no missing data in the gdf.

data(plethspecies)
Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethspecies$land, verbose = TRUE)
gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(Y.gpa)
gdf$d <- Y.gpa$procD
gdf$group <- c(rep(1, 4), rep(2, 4), NA) # one unknown group designation
na.omit(gdf) #works

gdf$group <- c(rep(1, 4), rep(2, 4), 1) # replace NA with 1
na.omit(gdf) #triggers error

Best, 
Bryan

On Fri, Jan 28, 2022 at 1:16 PM Tianqi Huang <huan...@gmail.com> wrote:

Dear all,

Because the “Independent variables are missing from either the data frame or global environment” error when trying to build a model using procD.lm with geomorph.data.frame, I applied the na.omit function to my gdf to remove missing values. However, I got the following error:

>Error in -omits : invalid argument to unary operator

A stack trace on this error showed that the same error appeared in all the following steps:

>Error in -omits : invalid argument to unary operator

>4: na.omit.rrpp.data.frame(object)

>3: na.omit(object)

>2: na.omit.geomorph.data.frame(gdf)

>1: na.omit(gdf)

I examined my data frame and my input data manually but did not find any issues. My R, Rstudio, and geomorph are all up to date. So, I was wondering if I am still missing something here.

Here are my codes (I am working on some snake head morphology data):

#####

#import landmark TPS file using readland.tps and rename as "lands"

#gpa

Y.gpa <-gpagen(lands)

#import independent variable txt files, "sex" and "site"

#create data frame

gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(Y.gpa,site,sex)

gdf$Site<-as.factor(gdf$Site)

gdf$Sex<-as.factor(gdf$Sex)

#na.omit function in geomorph v4.0.1

############# error message: “Error in -omits : invalid argument to unary operator”

gdf<- na.omit(gdf)

#build model (cannot work without the previous step)

fit <- procD.lm(coords ~ site * sex,

                 data = gdf, iter = 999,

                 RRPP = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE)

#####

Thank you very much in advance for the help!
